title: SimBench-BW roster
description: Canonical roster of SimBench-BW workload inputs. The row count follows the captured workload suite; rows carry build, launch, and family metadata consumed by workload tooling and full-corpus replay.

schema_version.description: Bumped whenever the row schema adds, removes, or renames a field.

rows.description: All benchmark rows. Ordering is stable per the reference roster enumeration (draft §5); downstream tools index by slug, not by position.

slug.description: Stable identifier used as the source filename stem and the key across all per-row artifacts.

level.description: Complexity level per draft §4e. L1 microbench, L2 fused-operator, L3 mini-block, L4 pipeline.

family.description: Fine-grained family within a domain (e.g. flash_attn, paged_attention, moe_grouped_gemm, rmsnorm, mamba_selective_scan).

primary_subsystems.description: Subsystems (S1–S20) that this row primary-stresses per the subsystem coverage matrix (draft §4b). Each row must primary-stress at least one subsystem; each subsystem must be primary-stressed by at least 3 non-control rows.

secondary_subsystems.description: Subsystems secondary-stressed by this row (non-load-bearing but measurable).

arch_gate.description: Architecture targets for which this row's .cu is expected to compile. Use the common.mk ARCH_GATE vocabulary.

tier.description: Portability tier. P allows arch-branched sources; P-strict is the optional branchless subset; H is Hopper-only; B is Blackwell-only; control is a vendor-library non-anchor kernel; unsupported is reserved for rows that cannot be built on any target platform.

trace_budget_mib.description: Declared NVBit trace budget in MiB per single-shape invocation. Semantics are enforced through workloads/simbench_bw/trace_budgets.toml.

walltime_target_ms.description: Target native wall-clock per invocation in milliseconds on the primary target hardware. See draft §4c level-bucket targets (2 / 5 / 20 / 50 ms for L1 / L2 / L3 / L4).

sm_meaningful.description: Y: single-SM invocation is a meaningful measurement. P: partially meaningful (e.g. an L3 block with an outer multi-SM loop). N: requires multi-SM execution.

deterministic.description: D: run-to-run deterministic under a fixed seed. ND: uses atomics / non-deterministic reduction; results compared under a wider tolerance per tolerances.toml.

reference_family.description: Reference-family module (under workloads/simbench_bw/references/<family>.py) that parametrically covers this row's correctness check. The suite caps at 20 families.

reference_type.description: How the correctness reference is produced. cpu: pure Python / NumPy / PyTorch on CPU. fp32_gpu: a higher-precision GPU reference path. analytic: closed-form result (e.g. identity for TMA copy).

seeds.description: When kind=sweep, explicit seed list documenting coverage.

seed.description: When kind=fixed, the single canonical seed.

citation.description: Citable source for the kernel's workload semantics (arXiv identifier, vendor doc URL, or local KB card path).

probe_dependencies.description: Feature keys whose probe outcome gates this row's tier. Empty list is only legal when tier is P-strict and the row has no arch-conditional dependency.

status.description: Lifecycle state. scaffold: metadata only, no .cu yet. scored: passed compile+run+correctness on every declared platform. build_failed / correctness_failed / unsupported: terminal non-scored states.

wave.description: Release-wave label; first-wave (MVS-20) rows carry wave=1. Union over all values equals the 72-row roster.

cross_gen_comparability_note.description: Hopper-vs-Blackwell behavioral comparability note. null is allowed only for rows that do not use TMA, clusters, DSMEM, or cluster-scoped mbarrier.

platform_matrix_override.description: Optional per-row override of platform_matrix.toml entry. When absent, the canonical platform_matrix.toml value is used; when present, workload tooling reports the declared override.
